characters.name: Cantarella
characters.quote: The sea is a mirror, it reflects the shape of your soul in it's tide.
characters.description: The Fisalia family's thirty-sixth head, Cantarella Fisalia. She locks your gaze with eyes as deep as the ocean, where dark tides seem to surge and swirl.

skills.name: Illusion Collapse
skills.description: Performs a series of attacks with her Rectifier

characters.name: Ciaccona
characters.quote: Off we go! May my poems light the way on your path ahead!
characters.description: A free-spirited, romantic, sincere, and passionate bard. On her journey, she sang radiant poems of saints and heroes, weaving tales of people, miracles, turmoil, and suffering.

characters.name: Jiyan
characters.quote: The wind carries my blade, and my blade carries justice.
characters.description: A member of the Midnight Rangers, Jiyan is a skilled warrior who uses the power of wind to enhance his combat abilities.

characters.name: Aalto
characters.quote: The Black Shores will always be my home, no matter where I go.
characters.description: A member of the Black Shores, Aalto is a skilled marksman who uses dual pistols infused with the power of wind.

characters.name: Jianxin
characters.quote: My fists are guided by the wind, and my heart by honor.
characters.description: A practitioner of Fengyiquan, Jianxin uses martial arts enhanced by the power of wind.

characters.name: Yangyang
characters.quote: The wind whispers secrets to those who listen carefully.
characters.description: A mysterious figure who harnesses the power of wind for both combat and healing.

characters.name: Calcharo
characters.quote: Lightning strikes where I command, and my blade follows.
characters.description: A member of the Ghost Hounds from Huanglong, Calcharo wields a massive broadblade charged with electric energy.

characters.name: Lumi
characters.quote: Logistics and lightning - both require precision and speed.
characters.description: A member of Lollo Logistics from Yuezhou, Lumi combines her business acumen with her electro powers.

characters.name: Changli
characters.quote: The flames of justice burn eternal in my blade.
characters.description: A representative of City Hall in Jinzhou, Changli uses her fusion powers to protect the citizens.

characters.name: Encore
characters.quote: Every performance deserves an encore, especially the final one.
characters.description: A member of the Black Shores, Encore uses her rectifier to channel fusion energy in devastating attacks.

characters.name: Chixia
characters.quote: The Public Security Bureau ensures that justice burns bright.
characters.description: A member of the Public Security Bureau in Huanglong, Chixia uses dual pistols infused with fusion energy.

characters.name: Mortefi
characters.quote: Fire cleanses all impurities, including doubt.
characters.description: A mysterious gunslinger who uses fusion-infused bullets to eliminate threats.

characters.name: Brant
characters.quote: The Troupe of Fools brings both entertainment and destruction.
characters.description: A member of the Troupe of Fools from Rinascita, Brant combines showmanship with deadly fusion attacks.

characters.name: Baizhi
characters.quote: Knowledge is like ice - beautiful, clear, and potentially dangerous.
characters.description: A scholar from Huaxu Academy in Jinzhou, Baizhi uses her rectifier to channel glacio energy for both offense and defense.

characters.name: Lingyang
characters.quote: The Liondance Troupe's performances are as beautiful as freshly fallen snow.
characters.description: A performer from the Liondance Troupe, Lingyang uses ice-infused martial arts in both performances and combat.

characters.name: Carlotta
characters.quote: The Montelli Family's influence is as vast as a glacier.
characters.description: A member of the Montelli Family from Rinascita, Carlotta uses dual pistols that fire ice-infused bullets.

characters.name: Camellya
characters.quote: Chaos is simply order waiting to be deciphered.
characters.description: A member of the Black Shores, Camellya wields a sword infused with havoc energy that can tear through reality.

characters.name: Danjin
characters.quote: The Midnight Rangers walk the line between order and chaos.
characters.description: A member of the Midnight Rangers, Danjin uses havoc energy to enhance his swordsmanship.

characters.name: Jinhsi
characters.quote: Light reveals truth, but sometimes truth is better left hidden.
characters.description: A representative of City Hall in Jinzhou, Jinhsi uses spectro energy to both illuminate and blind.

characters.name: Sanhua
characters.quote: Please don't stay too far away from me. I am confident to not let you get harmed in the slightest.
characters.description: A loyal and reliable guard for Jinhsi, Sanhua is composed and reserved. She perceives a world distinctly different from that in the eyes of others, and her body temperature is below normal.

characters.name: Shorekeeper
characters.quote: "The Shorekeeper"... This name suits me well enough. It aligns with my purpose and drive: they only exist because of you
characters.description: A mysterious figure from the Black Shores who wields a powerful rectifier infused with spectro energy.

characters.name: Rover
characters.quote: Is this the beginning of a new journey? Brimming with novel sounds, and untold stories...
characters.description: Awakened with an unknown past, Rover is an Arbiter who embarks on a journey to uncover the truth to regain their lost memories. As a unique Resonator, Rover can harness multiple elemental powers.

characters.name: Phoebe
characters.quote: The Order of the Deep holds many secrets, as do I.
characters.description: A mysterious member of the Order of the Deep from Rinascita, Phoebe uses her rectifier to channel spectro energy.

characters.name: Roccia
characters.quote: The Troupe of Fools brings entertainment through chaos.
characters.description: A powerful member of the Troupe of Fools from Rinascita, Roccia uses havoc-infused gauntlets in combat.

characters.name: Taoqi
characters.quote: Development requires both creation and destruction.
characters.description: A member of the Ministry of Development in Jinzhou, Taoqi wields a massive broadblade infused with havoc energy.

characters.name: Verina
characters.quote: The Pioneer Association lights the way for all.
characters.description: A member of the Pioneer Association in Jinzhou, Verina uses her rectifier to channel spectro energy for both exploration and combat.

characters.name: Xiangli Yao
characters.quote: Knowledge and power go hand in hand.
characters.description: A scholar from Huaxu Academy in Jinzhou, Xiangli Yao uses electro-infused gauntlets in combat.

characters.name: Yinlin
characters.quote: The Public Security Bureau ensures order through power.
characters.description: A member of the Public Security Bureau in Jinzhou, Yinlin uses her rectifier to channel electro energy.

characters.name: Youhu
characters.quote: The cold never bothered me anyway.
characters.description: A resident of Chongzi in Huanglong, Youhu uses ice-infused gauntlets in combat.

characters.name: Yuanwu
characters.quote: Assuming I've thought my decisions through and acted with integrity, I am content.
characters.description: He owns a boxing gym where he teaches martial arts and health management, and is well-respected in the community for his cordial demeanor and pleasant temperament.

characters.name: Zani
characters.quote: Work will keep coming. Don't forget to live a little.
characters.description: She is a staff member of the Montelli Family's Averardo Bank in Ragunna. As a serious and reliable Montelli employee, Zani follows a strict routine and manages tasks with ease. For years, she has clocked in on time without fail, finding as much enjoyment in her well-ordered life as in her carefully planned moments of leisure.

characters.name: Zhezhi
characters.quote: What I wanted to say is, the sunlight on you right now is so beautiful, Can I... paint you?
characters.description: She is a commissioned painter, quiet and shy with a dedication to her craft. She's not very eloquent, but her persistence and love for painting speak volumes.

characters.name: Cartethyia
characters.quote: The crown of winds... has been engulfed by the sea. Tell me, are you the one who summoned this blade?
characters.description: Throughout Rinascita, she is revered as Fleurdelys, the "Blessed Maiden," and in some accounts, "The Martyred Maiden." As a key figure in the region’s history, she holds profound influence, with her connections to the Sentinel Imperator, the Threnodian Leviathan, and the Dark Tide. Her true desires, however, lie in freeing herself from the shackles of her titles and living out her days as a just and righteous wandering knight.

characters.name: Lupa
characters.quote: Oh, is a new match calling?
characters.description: She is a gladiator from Septimont, a warrior and undefeated champion of the arena with both an untamed, competitive spirit and an honorable, valiant heart. While indulging in the adrenaline of hard-fought victories, she is also a loyal, prideful protector of her city and upholds its values with everything she holds dear.

characters.name: Phrolova
characters.quote: Come, let us finish this performance we've all been waiting for. Together.
characters.description: She is a particularly powerful Resonator and a former Overseer of the Fractsidus. Her forte can manipulate and transfigure the frequencies of humans, Echoes, and Tacet Discords alike.

characters.name: Augusta
characters.quote: With the blazing sun as witness... Glory, bow before us.
characters.description: The fearless Ephor of Septimont with a will of iron, she remains a fiercely resilient yet humble leader despite the immeasurable hardships of her childhood and tenure as a Gladiator. Though a mere mortal, she has mastered the arts of combat, strategy, and her Forte through countless conflicts, reaching heights few others like her have ever attempted to reach.

characters.name: Iuno
characters.quote: Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.
characters.description: She is a prodigious and renowned Priestess of Septimont's Tetragon Temple, charged with delivering prophecies that shape the lives of its citizens. While both blessed and cursed with the power to foretell the futures of others, her responsibilities are contrasted by her cocky, outspoken and rebellious attitude, embodying an eagerness to defy all of fate's cruelest machinations.

characters.name: Galbrena
characters.quote: Who's my next prey?
characters.description: Once a Septimontian known as "Angel", she is now a formidable "Discord Slayer" who wields the ability to consume the frequencies and powers of Tacet Discords she hunts across Solaris-3, with the aid of the notorious Chimera. Her identity as a "Fiend of Ever-Burning Flame", a huntress spoken in legend corrupted by the Dark Tide, is now reborn anew with her responsibilities as a Consultant of the Black Shores.

characters.name: Qiuyuan
characters.quote: Name the target. I'll take care of the rest.
characters.description: Former senior agent of Mingting's Internal Security Agency, he is a swordsman of cool resilience and absolute integrity, wandering Huanglong alone and seeks not fame nor high office, but mastery of swordsmanship and a life guided by high morals. He was framed by the Grand Architect for the murder of his master, and is now a fugitive throughout all of Huanglong.

characters.name: Chisa
characters.quote: I will… sever this deadlock.
characters.description: Chisa is a conscientious, level-headed student from the Startorch Academy. To her, everything can be broken down, analyzed, and resolved, with the exception of human bonding. Bonds can be severed, but this fragility is what makes them precious.

characters.name: Buling
characters.quote: Exorcism, talisman divination, fortune-telling... you name it, I 'bling' it!
characters.description: She is a Black Shores Consultant, known as the "Spiritchaser Taoist," who wanders far and wide investigating and sharing the strange and mysterious. She is a master of fortune-telling, feng shui, and other arts of divination. To cover the expenses in her travels, she sells talismans and offers her divination services, which she thinks of as a sort of guidance for those in need.

characters.name: Lynae
characters.quote: Outlaw Blue, Apollo Orange, Hazard Yellow, Acid Green... Wanna guess what color is my next pick?
characters.description: She is a Preparatory Program student at Startorch Academy and a free spirit who lives every day to its fullest. Before attending Startorch, she was a mercenary from the Lawless Zone in the New Federation. In order to escape from the Lawless Zone and gain her freedom, she stole the identity of the real Lynae — a Fractsidus operative, who was attending Startorch Academy as a spy.

characters.name: Mornye
characters.quote: I need not wait for a starry night, nor tilt my gaze to seek the sky. For I have placed it at my back, in my hands, and upon my eyelids.
characters.description: She is a researcher for the Spacetrek Collective and a professor for Exostrider Engineering at Startorch Academy. She was a student at Startorch Academy and an acquaintance of Rover 20 years before the Void Storm hit Lahai-Roi. With an unwavering dream to chart the course of humanity's exploration of the world beyond Solaris, she plays a key role in the technological developments of Lahai-Roi as a project head of the Spacetrek Collective Research Institute.

characters.name: Aemeath
characters.quote: Did you see me?
characters.description: She is a Frostlands native from the Roya Tribe who was once a Synchronist at Startorch Academy. She became the Exostrider's Resonator after overclocking in order to resonate with it, causing her to lose her body. She now roams throughout Lahai-Roi as a digital ghost invisible to everyone around her except for Rover, whom she met with during her childhood.

characters.name: Luuk Herssen
characters.quote: I've already bid farewell to the self buried beneath the frostlands. When the snow thaws... we'll meet again among the new blooms of spring.
characters.description: He is the head physician of the Resonator Nursing Unit at Startorch Academy, serving as an attending medical doctor and mental health counselor, with a mysterious past.

characters.name: Sigrika
characters.quote: I'll keep all of this in my heart forever.
characters.description: She is a student in the Preparatory Program at Startorch Academy and a member of its Birding Fan Club as well as a from the Roya Tribe. Although she shoulders the heavy responsibility of being a Heliodic Six Successor, she is an overwhelmingly kind and gentle woman dedicated to helping her classmates through their struggles.

characters.name: Hiyuki
characters.quote: The Collective pursues what is right, but your quest to save [[Aemeath
characters.description: She is a and member of the Special Response Force with a long-standing connection to the Threnodians. Her stoic, aloof demeanor and formidable combat experience conceal guilt and regret for failing to protect her homeland that continues to weigh heavily in her heart. Having served as a miko for over a century, Hiyuki derives her most anomalous capabilities from "Suzu", one of the five Legacy Talismans left behind by the Sentinels, which grants the bearer the ability to perceive and utilize "certain possibilities" of oneself.

characters.name: Denia
characters.quote: Shh... Keep this between us, will you?
characters.description: She is a student from Startorch Academy's Department of Voidmatters with a sardonic nihilism, who secretly serves as an agent for the Fractsidus. Despite being created by Schwarzloch for the purpose of becoming the Resonator of the Threnodian Aleph-1, she harbors deep-seated fear and resentment towards the Fractsidus and her creator. No matter the price, even her own existence, she is determined to use her "gift" to protect those dearest to her.

characters.name: Lucy
characters.quote: Don't make a name for yourself by how you live... but by how you die.
characters.description: She is a part of the collaboration with .

characters.name: Rebecca
characters.quote: C'mon, need to hit somethin'!
characters.description: She is a part of the collaboration with .

characters.name: Lucilla
characters.quote: My dream now is just to see all my students' dreams come true.
characters.description: She is the president and the head of Startorch Academy. She was the former chief editor for the New Federation's top academic journal and an associate of Mortefi.

characters.name: Yangyang Xuanling
characters.quote: ...Long time no see, Rover.
characters.description: Once an Outrider for the Midnight Rangers, she's now an acting of Xuanfang Hold.

characters.name: Suisui
characters.quote: Where clear streams flow, there spring awaits.
characters.description: Born into a noble family of Mingting, she is the brilliant young director of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild.

characters.name: Qingxiao
characters.quote: On the qin strings do eons sing, eternal peace my blade shall bring.
characters.description: A reclusive sword cultivator who holds the nominal title of Xuan Paragon of Xuanfang Hold, and a peerless master of both qin and sword.

characters.name: Jingran
characters.quote: Straight to the underworld... Couldn't have asked for better.
characters.description: Unknown

characters.name: Hsin
characters.quote: To walk among their joys, and stand guard... over the everglowing lanterns.
characters.description: She is also known as "The Moon Fox" or Hsin (Heart), and is one of Huanglong's seven Sentinels who is located in Mengzhou.

characters.name: Suoming
characters.quote: 'Let go. Forget'... I've heard those words a thousand times. I've said them to myself a thousand more. But this obsession... this is exactly what I want.
characters.description: Unknown
